column_description: Primary key (VARCHAR(30)) for an investigation record (e.g., 'INV-abc123').
An enum (InvestStat_enum) for investigation status (Monitoring, Closed, Active).
An enum (RiskLevel_enum) for law enforcement interest (Low, Medium, High, Unknown).
An enum (RiskLevel_enum) describing regulatory risk (Low, Medium, High, Unknown).
A NUMERIC(4,2) (0–99.99) measuring how compliant the subject is (e.g., 75.50).
An enum (InvestPriority_enum) for priority (Low, Medium, High).
An INT for average response time in minutes (e.g., 45).
An enum (EscalationLevel_enum) describing how far it's escalated (Level1, Level2, Level3).
An enum (CaseStatus_enum) describing the case state (New, In Progress, Resolved, Closed).
A SMALLINT for hours from case open to resolution (e.g., 72).
An enum (ActionTaken_enum) describing final actions (Termination, Warning, Restriction).
An enum (FollowupRequired_enum) (Yes, No) for follow-up necessity.
An enum (ReviewFrequency_enum) for re-check intervals (Weekly, Monthly, Daily).
A DATE specifying the next scheduled review (e.g., '2025-06-01').
A SMALLINT tally of internal notes on the case (e.g., 4).
An enum (DataRetentionStatus_enum) describing how data is stored (Deleted, Active, Archived).
A TIMESTAMP capturing last update time (e.g., '2025-03-30 14:00:00').
An INT for how often the case is updated or reviewed automatically (e.g., 24).
FK referencing SecurityMonitoring(SecMonRegistry). Ties the investigation to security data.
FK referencing RiskAnalysis(RiskRegistry). Associates the investigation with a risk record.
